LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription: FBC: Firebreak is a cooperative first-person shooter set within a mysterious federal agency under assault by otherworldly forces. As a years-long siege on the agency’s headquarters reaches a breakpoint, only Firebreak—the Bureau’s most versatile unit—has the gear and the guts to plunge into the building’s strangest crises, restore order, and blast their way back from the brink.
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: FBC: Firebreak is a cooperative first-person shooter set within a mysterious federal agency under assault by otherworldly forces.

Features: Dive into the Federal Bureau of Control’s (FBC) unpredictable and extradimensional headquarters during its darkest—and strangest—hours.
As one of the FBC’s fearless first responders, you and your team are on call to confront everything from reality-warping anomalies to otherworldly monsters.
Join forces with friends or strangers to tackle crisis as a well-oiled crew. Survival in this three-player cooperative FPS hinges on quick thinking and seamless teamwork.
Before deploying, select your weapon and customize your Firebreaker’s Crisis Kit with specialized tools, grenades, support items, and paranatural augments.
Experiment with different loadouts to perfect your playstyle and synergize with your team, giving you the edge to succeed in every crisis, no matter the difficulty.
Return to the strange and unexpected world of Control or venture in for the first time in this standalone, multiplayer experience.
